2.2 [PARTY_C] will provide the system / platform maintenance services and data processing services to PC Financial.
findings.explanation: You are required to deliver maintenance and data processing services without any defined limits or a change‑order process, so the client could keep requesting more work.
findings.suggested_change: 2.2 [PARTY_C] will provide the system/platform maintenance services and data processing services to PC Financial as specifically described in Schedule A, and any additional services shall be subject to a written change order signed by both parties.

findings.quoted_text: After PC Financial confirms that invoice contents are correct, PC Financial shall pay within 45 days after confirming thus.
findings.explanation: You will have to wait up to 45 days after the invoice is approved before receiving payment, which is longer than the usual 30‑day window and can hurt cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: PC Financial shall pay the invoice within 30 days of receipt of a correct invoice.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I hope you are well. Before signing, I would like to clarify a couple of points in the agreement:

- The relevant clause 2.2 states that [PARTY_C] will provide system/platform maintenance services and data processing services to PC Financial. As written, there is no limit or change‑order process, which could lead to open‑ended requests. I propose that the clause read: “[PARTY_C] will provide the system/platform maintenance services and data processing services to PC Financial as specifically described in Schedule A, and any additional services shall be subject to a written change order signed by both parties.”
- The payment clause currently requires PC Financial to pay within 45 days after confirming invoice contents. This payment period exceeds the typical 30‑day term and may affect cash flow. I suggest revising it to: “PC Financial shall pay the invoice within 30 days of receipt of a correct invoice.”

Thank you for considering these adjustments. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards
